data.description: When a leprechaun uses any of its spell-like abilities to deceive, trick, or humiliate a creature (at the GM's discretion), the spell-like ability resolves at caster level 8th rather than 4th.  If a leprechaun uses its spell-like abilities in this manner, it has a bonus of +11 on concentration checks.
data.name: Leprechaun Magic
